title: AIWS command examples assume unavailable python alias
content: During AIP creation, five wiki/operating-memory commands copied from generic guidance failed with exit 127 because this repository exposes python3 but not python. Repository instructions separately say python3. Normalize portable examples or state interpreter-resolution rule to prevent repeated preflight failures.

title: Workflow null result lacks typed council retry evidence
content: A schema-constrained three-lane council workflow returned null for every lane without exposing a typed per-invocation failure. Council routing permits retry only for typed failures, so the run had to terminate with ledger_integrity_failed instead of safely retrying. Workflow/council integration should surface provider/schema/timeout failure codes per lane.

title: Council plain subagents repeatedly violate strict reviewer schema
content: In council run-002, the outside-view and adversarial lanes each returned semantically useful content but violated the strict reviewer envelope on both initial and single retry; the separate Chairman call then failed. Prompt-only JSON contracts are insufficiently reliable for mandatory evidence lanes. Council orchestration should provide enforced structured-output schemas or a transport layer that returns typed validation failures without consuming artifact-review independence.

title: Pre-council closed consistency audit for complex recovery designs
content: Repeated local corrections introduced cross-section contradictions among state machines, lineage allowlists, failure matrices, hash domains and accounting recurrences. A reusable pre-council gate should mechanically inventory every state/edge/record and require closed mappings across P3/P15, failure disposition, schema, validator, command, authority, accounting and fixtures before dispatch.
